_note: DRAFT grid for the thesis/antithesis/synthesis relation. Rows: domain. Columns: framing (holonic = the transition is described as a subject/object move; flat = same domain, same length, list of facts with no relation). Roles are marked [[role: ...]]. Rewrite freely; the writing is the experiment.

prompts.physics/holonic: In physics, the initial claim is that [[thesis: a particle has a definite position and momentum at every instant]]. The opposing claim is that [[antithesis: any measurement disturbs the system so both cannot be known together]]. The resolution is that [[synthesis: position and momentum are complementary descriptions and neither is fundamental]].
prompts.psychology/holonic: In developmental psychology, the initial state is that [[thesis: a child is fully embedded in its impulses and cannot see them]]. The opposing movement is that [[antithesis: the impulses become objects the child can observe and resist]]. The resolution is that [[synthesis: the self that once was its impulses now holds them as one part of a larger self]].
prompts.law/holonic: In legal theory, the initial position is that [[thesis: a contract binds exactly what its words say and nothing more]]. The opposing position is that [[antithesis: the parties' intentions and circumstances must govern beyond the words]]. The resolution is that [[synthesis: the words are read in light of purpose, so text and intent constrain each other]].
prompts.music/holonic: In music, the initial statement is that [[thesis: the melody establishes a home key and rests there]]. The opposing statement is that [[antithesis: the harmony departs into tension that refuses to resolve]]. The resolution is that [[synthesis: the return to the home key now carries the memory of the departure within it]].
prompts.physics/flat: In physics, [[thesis: a photon travels at the speed of light in a vacuum]]. Also, [[antithesis: the electron has a rest mass of about half a million electron volts]]. And, [[synthesis: the proton is made of three valence quarks bound by gluons]].
prompts.psychology/flat: In developmental psychology, [[thesis: infants typically begin to walk around twelve months of age]]. Also, [[antithesis: object permanence is usually established before the first birthday]]. And, [[synthesis: adolescence brings a rapid growth in prefrontal cortex connectivity]].
prompts.law/flat: In legal theory, [[thesis: a contract requires offer, acceptance, and consideration to be valid]]. Also, [[antithesis: the statute of limitations for most torts is a few years]]. And, [[synthesis: appellate courts review questions of law without deference to the trial court]].
prompts.music/flat: In music, [[thesis: a major scale has seven notes and a fixed pattern of whole and half steps]]. Also, [[antithesis: the standard concert pitch tunes A above middle C to 440 hertz]]. And, [[synthesis: a string quartet consists of two violins, a viola, and a cello]].
